blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: - A plugin system for export formats, so that PDF, XLSX, XML and JSON exports can be added later by dropping a module in `src/export/plugins/`.
findings.recommendation: The Why only asks that accountants stop copying invoices one by one into their spreadsheet ("Accountants copy invoices one by one into their spreadsheet at the end of each month."); a single CSV route answers it. Drop the plugin registry from the proposal, the design decision "Exports go through a plugin registry" (whose only argument against a single CSV function is "not extensible", for formats nobody requested) and task 1.2, which has no requirement or scenario behind it ("verified by `npm test -- registry`"). Propose the registry in its own change when a second format is actually needed.
findings.title: Plugin system for export formats nobody asked for

findings.evidence: The settings page SHALL let a user choose their preferred export format among the installed plugins.
findings.location: specs/invoice-export/spec.md#Requirement: Users choose their export format
findings.recommendation: Nothing in the Why asks for a per-user format preference, and with CSV as the only format the choice is empty. The requirement is also not verifiable as written: the export route is fixed to `/invoices.csv`, so "**THEN** exports use CSV" cannot observe the preference having any effect. Remove this requirement, the "A settings page where each user picks their preferred export format." bullet, `web/src/settings/` from Impact, the last sentence of the design decision and task 2.1.
findings.title: Settings page for a preferred export format is out of scope

findings.recommendation: The change adds a route, `GET /invoices.csv?month=YYYY-MM`, that returns a month's invoices with their customer and total, yet `security` and `personal-data` are unticked with no reason, so no expert will review who may call it or what customer data leaves the system; the spec has no scenario for an unauthenticated or unauthorized caller. As planned, the settings page also touches `user-interface`, unticked. Tick each domain the plan touches, or give the reason it does not on its line (if R-skeptic-2 removes the settings page, `user-interface` can stay unticked with that reason).
findings.title: Domains the plan touches are left unticked without a reason

findings.evidence: - **THEN** the CSV holds every invoice of September 2026
findings.location: specs/invoice-export/spec.md#Requirement: Invoices are exported as CSV
findings.recommendation: The plan does not say which date places an invoice in a month (issue date, due date) nor in which time zone, so an invoice issued near midnight on a month boundary may land in either export. State the rule in the requirement and add a boundary scenario.
findings.title: Which invoices belong to a month is not defined
